purpose: This form is used for making an application under section 14 for the conversion of a public company into a private company.
who: Regional Director receives the application filed by the company
when: Within sixty days from the date of passing of special resolution
steps: Pass a special resolution for the conversion.
Attach the required documents and fee.
File the application with the Regional Director within sixty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
checklist: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting with vote details and names of dissenters
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney authorising the application
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding non-compliance of specific sections
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and delisting status
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting at which the special resolution was passed
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding compliance
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and delisting
watch: Ensure the application is filed within sixty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
